root.label: Jay Jacobs wins new New York Democratic chair term

events.label: Jay Jacobs wins new New York Democratic chair term

slots.name: weighted vote share
slots.sentence: Jacobs — who angered the left last year by declining to endorse then-Democratic mayoral nominee Zohran Mamdani in the general election — faced a challenge from Otsego County chair Caitlin Ogden.

slots.name: term length
slots.sentence: State Democratic Committee Chair Jay Jacobs handily won a new two-year term on the job, receiving 82 percent of the weighted vote at a party gathering in Westchester today.
